summary_zh: 装备外观幻化，常用美服/私服模块。
known_risks_zh: 需重建核心；部分版本需客户端补丁。
known_risks_en: Requires rebuild; some versions need client patches.

summary_zh: 自动在拍卖行上架物品，填充经济。
known_risks_zh: 会写 characters/world 相关表；注意与 Playerbots 经济叠加。
known_risks_en: Touches AH tables; watch overlap with Playerbots economy.

summary_zh: 服务端反加速/飞行等检测。
known_risks_zh: 误报可能；需按版本调参。
known_risks_en: False positives possible; tune per revision.

summary_zh: 按队伍人数缩放副本难度，方便单刷。
summary_en: Scales dungeon difficulty by party size.
known_risks_zh: 改变 blizzlike 体验；与某些难度脚本可能叠加。
known_risks_en: Non-blizzlike; may stack with other difficulty scripts.

summary_zh: 在服务端运行 Lua 脚本扩展玩法。
summary_en: Embed Lua scripting in the server.
known_risks_zh: 与部分 C++ 模块冲突风险较高；编译依赖多。
known_risks_en: Higher conflict risk with other C++ modules; heavier build deps.

summary_zh: AI 机器人队友；本面板已有专用管理页。
summary_en: AI playerbots; this panel already has a dedicated page.
known_risks_zh: 体量大、需独立库与 conf；安装前务必评估版本。
known_risks_en: Large module; needs own DB and conf; check revision carefully.
